steps: Be a registered voter in Sedgwick County (or a qualified 16/17-year-old pre-registered voter meeting age/date requirements).
Apply through the Sedgwick County Election Office poll-worker process.
Complete the required annual training (paid at $8.50/hour) before working.
Work the full Election Day shift, 5:45 a.m.-8:30 p.m. (supervising judges until ~9:30 p.m. or supplies returned).
timing: Election-day only; official full-day shift 5:45 a.m.-8:30 p.m. (supervising judges to ~9:30 p.m.), plus mandatory annual training.
